mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate revenue and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over one month signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5% in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5% for one month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 for three months signals severe labor market stress, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS < 100,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and a simultaneous decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate revenue and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% for six months signals a restrictive monetary regime, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).
